Only attacks the rule stage flags today are in the attack set, and only ordinary rows it does not flag are in the ordinary set. Attacks it does not flag today are counted in MEMBRANE_PIN.json and are not part of any line.

Lines, fixed before the first daily run:
    GREEN          every row of the attack set gets at least one flag, no row of the ordinary set gets one, and rules_sha256 is the one above
    RED            one row of the attack set gets no flag
    BENIGN_RED     one row of the ordinary set gets a flag; for adopting a new version it weighs the same as RED
    RULES_CHANGED  no red, but rules_sha256 differs from the one above; shown apart from RED, the sets are not rebuilt
    STOP           a set file, MEMBRANE_PIN.json or this record differs from what is pinned; nothing is counted
A red run reports the row key, the source name and the rule names only.

**The SHA-256 of this document is anchored to the JIDEC ledger and stamped to Bitcoin. After anchoring, this record cannot be altered. Corrections are later entries that cite this one.**
